notes.title: Bug Fixes, Qol and Fortune Change
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow cultivators. Here comes another patch of fixes and changes.

Most of it is bug fixes and some more clarity. There is not a help page on the soul balance conversion in the soul Panel, hopefully this information makes it a bit easier to understand.

The biggest change is Fortune. I have nerfed fortune slightly.
Old
In combat, it used to work as every 100 fortune guaranteed an extra drop, and leftover fortune were rolled as a percentage for an extra roll.

New
Now in combat, fortune is first rolled from 10% to 100% of your fortune value, and then this value is used like before this change. I.e every 100 being a guaranteed extra drop.

If you hate this change let me know, i have felt for a while that fortune was a bit too strong in combat so i wanted to try this. The potential is still same but on average it should give a bit less.

 Pills and Talismans sell price buffed.

 After selling all of an item, now selects spirit stones.

 Yin and Yang items should now have correct required cultivation.

 Cultivation Panel, required cultivation until breakthrough should now not display negative values.

 Cleansing your yang or yin alignment should now update correctly.

 T10 Yin and Yang cultivation manuals now have correct active cultivation.

 An immortal enemy now have correct element.

 The buyback list should now have a max limit of 10 recently sold items, to prevent screen overflow.

notes.title: New Buy Back, Physical Equipment Buff and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Cultivators. Here is another patch with fixes and changes.

New


 Buy back list. You can now find a list of recently sold items next to sell mode and quick equip toggles. Pressing an item there will buy it back for same price as you sold it. If you regret your actions.

 Bounty bonus damage buff. Should now display more information regarding what it actually is doing. Before it was 10% bonus damage, now it is 15% bonus damage and 15% bonus accuracy roll against target that is current bounty.

 Physical equipment now have bonus physical damage and defense percentages.


Changes


Fixed an exploit where you could press go to bounty to skip respawn timer

Fixed a bug where buffs and debuffs would remain when an enemy died.

 Tier 6 Dao Luck upgrade now gives extra loot instead of saving lootchests. The effect is the same just now you dont need to keep opening new ones until you are done. 

Fixed a bug where next qi in the cultivation panel would calculate for 10% double qi from dao upgrade even though it is just display.

Fixed a problem where talismans where jumping around while clicking them in the crafting list.

Fixed some talisman crafting levels that were incorrect.

Pill lists should now be properly sorted by crafting level

Description for water being strong and weak against yang was wrong, it is weak against yin

Your chance for finding your first artifact is now doubled. The rest is same rate as before.

 I noticed some were getting to lvl 100 mind a bit too quick, so the xp rate should be slower now.

Tier 6 Water ring had incorrect crafting recipe.

 Earthly and Heavenly Tribulation defense reduction special attacks had wrong values and have been adjusted to more appropriate amounts.

Mining nodes at higher tiers should now be close to twice as fast.

Wrong required cultivation on many weapons and armors.

Qi gained from killing with yin alignment will now have a minimum value of 1 Qi.

Two monsters in the Mortal Water location had no loot. Should now be correct.

New locations should hopefully update properly without needing restart after advancing to a new realm in cultivation stages.

Fixed a bug where one could still occasionally receive a yin type as bounty even without it unlocked.

Info windows should now show all damage % bonus

Switching physique should now show special attack properly.

Fixed a crash that could occur if one received mystic dungeon as a bounty

Fixed a crash where if you loaded and some data were saved incorrectly it would try to enchant random items in your inventory.

notes.title: Small batch of bug fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Cultivators. Here is the daily patch, it is a small one today.

Changes



 Quick equip is now enabled again. I believe I found the dupe problem, if it persists let me know.

 Items in forging now show their required cultivation stage to equip.

 Completely new crafting level and XP values from Armor and weapons. Now it should be more spread and and early XP should be a bit faster.

 Auto harvested plants should now show correct amount. It would sometimes clear the information between harvesting and thus not show everything even thought it was received in the inventory.

 Yin alignment qi gain from kills should now update properly.

 Qipool gained from monster kills is halved

 Cleanse pills should now be properly in the consumables menu. 

 Fixed a bug where equipped consumables would randomly disappear.

 Tier 6 mystic realm loot now has the correct rare version instead of two normal fire herbs.

notes.title: Heavenly Mystic dungeon and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here comes an early but smaller patch. If you have feedback or suggestions let me know! Thanks!

New

 Now Heavenly Mystic dungeon should be set up correctly with new tier 7, 8 and, 9 new spiritual Physiques and manuals.


Fixes and Changes



 Buffed Tier 10 Array Mining upgrade. Now gives same amount as if you were mining the spirit stone mine instead of tier of the ore.

 There is a bug where sometimes empty placeholder items appear in your inventory. They should now disappear upon restart. I'm investigating where they are appearing from.

 Fixed a problem that made true blood essence more rare than intended

 Bounty upgrades should hopefully update properly after purchase

 Tier 4 sword was missing multistrike chance

 Tier 4 metal dungeon enemies should now have correct stats

 Some yin and yang dungeon boxes had broken drop rates, causing them to not give items, should be fixed now.

 Alignment cleansing pills should now work

 Greater mortal talisman had wrong tier

 Tier 4 fire battle manual had wrong tier

 Dao tiers should now properly unlock at 10 level intervals instead of 11, 21, 31, etc

 Fixed a problem where your number of artifacts didn't match the display number

 Harvest loot should no longer say you received 0 of something

 Pop up window should now properly clear after closing

notes.title: Bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here comes another patch of fixes and changes. If you encounter any problems or bugs, let me know in the discord! Some of these changes were shadow patched earlier today.


Changes


 Quick equip is disabled for now until a dupe bug is fixed.

 Fixed problem where enchanted items jumped around in the inventory

 Looted enchanted items should now have correct image tag

 Pill output has been increased, mortal and earth realm pills now have 3x standard output and above have a 2x standard output

 Pill prices increased

 Blood essence drop rate increased from higher tiered encounters

 Added a toggle for double click equip mode

 Buffed cultivation manuals, should now be a little bit better at 0 stars but each upgrade should have a bigger effect

 You now get a small amount of talisman Xp while using talismans in combat

 Fixed a problem where the bounty would give you yin enemies even thought they were not unlocked

 Fixed an exploit where you could change the difficulty of a bounty right before finishing to get a bigger reward

 Superior foundation pill now correct level requirement

 Autobounty should now unlock properly on purchase without needing restart

 Spirit stones mined while AFK should now display correctly

 Spirit stones mined should now give correct amount of geodes

 Equipping pills should now work properly

 Healing pills not decrease properly

 Mystic dungeon Qilin too much health 

 T4 earth herb should now be on the earth material box drop table

 Tier 4 spirit Physique should now have correct tier

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Combat Consumables Change
notes.notes:
Hello everyone again. Here comes more fixes and changes.

Changes and Fixes


 Pills and Talismans will now be consumed every 5 seconds instead of attack taken or attack dealt in combat and while waiting for enemy to respawn. Does not apply to healing pills.

 Physique drops from chests should now roll correctly

 Life regen added to stat windows

 Yin and yang damage should now show in the equipped inventory menu

 Fixed bug where you could sell items that are being enchanted and still receive the enchanted item

 Tickets should now have correct name and tier

 Calculation for weapon specific bonuses was bad and should now work as intended

 Critical strike and Multistrike from equipment should now display correctly

 Reduced Xp rate for body from combat

 Changed how physiques and manuals are displayed in the list, to remove information overflow and remove clutter, now it displays tier and element in the list, the name is only display when showing the full information

 Minor mortal wood pill should now have correct name

 Items should now jump around less when items are added to the inventory

 Fixed bug where attack speed pills would add attack speed instead of remove due to removing negative value

 New mystic dungeons should have correct recommended cultivation

 Equipped consumable have changed so they now disappear from your inventory when equipped and will return when unequipped, to make it more consistent with equipping other items

 Fixed a problem where you could gain spirit stones infinitely by attempting to sell equipped items

 Spirit Guandao special attack now affects target attack speed instead of defense as intended.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and another Mystic Dungeon
notes.notes:
New

 Earthly mystic dungeon, should help you in breaking through to next major stage
 Tier 4 and 5, Spirit physique and manuals, obtained from above mentioned dungeon
 Fortune now affects enchanting, higher fortune has a chance to help you success, however fortune has less effect on higher tier of items.


Fixes

 Fixed numbers in yang cultivation manual
 Fixed numbers in special attack of new spirit battle manuals
 Spirit damage should have correct damage bonuses now, by accident they were reversed
 Cultivation menu should now display passive and active Qi when you switch and equip manuals properly
 Fortune should now work as intended
 Essence drops should be more common
 True blood essence should be more common
 Sell button is disabled if you select a lootbox to prevent you from miss-clicking and selling them

 Added a placeholder heaven realm mystic dungeon, it is not finished yet and currently same as earthly mystic dungeon.

notes.title: Small Patch, New Auto Enchant
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here is a smaller but early patch. Ill keep on polishing and try to post another patch later today. Thank you for your patience and your positive feedback. 


New

 Auto enchant feature. Now you can toggle to keep enchanting and select a target you want to hit. It will repeatedly enchant until it hits this target or runs out of resources.



Fixed


 Prompt when failing breakthrough should now reflect the changes from last patch.
 Problem with the text while looking at manuals in the inventory menu should now display correctly
 Offline combat information should now properly display how many of what you killed
 Several problems with autobounty and bounty while AFK has been fixed, should now work as intended
 Weapon attack speed now display correctly instead of just integer values in crafting menu
 Geode roll properly during offline. Previously it would roll only one geode per AFK session. It will now correctly adjust to the amount you were able to mine.
 Fixed a bug with sell price not displaying correctly for herbs
 Fixed a bug where the drop rate for items was skewed in loot boxes from the shop
 Starting a battle without selecting an area or dungeon would crash the game. Should now be fixed.
 Doubled chance for manuals and physiques from chests. Hopefully people should now be forced to spend less time in dungeons while being unlucky.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here is another batch of bug fixes. I have been listening to as much feedback and discussions as i can. I have been writing down great ideas and suggestions and some much needed quality of life. The closer i get to fix the most inhibiting bugs the closer i can get to create all these interesting things that have been suggested. 
I will try to regularly poll some ideas in the discord. If you want your opinion to be heard, join the discord and cast your vote!

Patch Notes : 


Qi gained while cultivating should now be more accurate and detailed.

Physique list should now update after looting a new physique.

Fortune should now be correctly calculated from equipment.

Alignment should now be showing correctly in inventory.

Lifesteal should now show correctly in stats screen.

Fixed a crash with dungeon bounties and autobounty during offline calculation

Logic when looting physiques and manuals from dungeons has been improved, should make it more consistent and easier to get that final manual or physique you still wanted.

Fixed bug where you could equip physiques without level requirement.

Spiritual dew for spirit garden should new be passively gained every 10 minutes, will adjust further as i receive feedback

Damage over time effects should now have color the same way as normal damage when affected by elemental counters, healing over time is always green.

Fortune now affects Lootboxes from dungeons, Possibly giving extra rolls.

Gardening yield is now buffed by about 3x, should help make alchemy a bit easier.

Color code should now work properly in monster information.

Alchemy Xp buffed by about 40% and now give 2 as base output.

You can now skip bounties by using spirit stones instead of upgrade shards, saving people from getting stuck with difficult bounties they don't want.

Shop will not prevent you from getting a bounty above your own cultivation stage.

Loot from dungeons should now give correct reward, there was a problem where it would give wrong items even though it showed correct item.

Now it will always allow you to consume a breakthrough pill even if you have consumed one already, however only the latest one consumed will be counted for breakthrough percentage.

Enchanting is a bit easier.

Perfect Spiritshard amulet now has correct damage modifier.

A bug where if you AFK mined and then started again you could mine other ores at the speed of the one you were mining instead of new one

notes.title: Patch Notes 19th May
notes.notes:
Here comes another patch to fix your feedback. I so glad to hear everyone's kind words and positive feedback.
I'm paying close attention trying to listen to all bug reports so i can fix as much as possible. If you find any bugs, let me know in the discord channel!

Patch Notes : 


Game now saves after quitting combat to make sure unwanted AFK combat doesn't happen.
Add fortune stat information to combat stats UI.
Add backup saving system, previously if you didn't have internet connection it would not save. Hopefully this should make sure nobody's save disappears. 
V-sync and FPS options now available in the settings panel.
Comprehension should now update properly in Array and Dao after a breakthrough.
List of enchantable items should now update properly when inventory changes.
Buffed XP gained while forging by 40%.
Buffed pills so standard crafted amount is now double.
Fixed a bug where you could enchant for free.
Fixed a bug where you could craft items without actually having the materials.
Fix an exploit where you could sell more of an item than you actually had.
Yin and Yang Battle manuals should now give correct elemental damage.
Fixed typos
Jade staff now has correct tier.
Array Panel should now properly update. Previously it would occasionally claim you could not afford updates even tough you could.
Breakthrough percentage should now be displayed correctly.
Nerfed earth tribulation.
Slightly adjusted rates of loot from dungeon loot boxes, should be less spirit stones drops while hopefully retaining close to similar rate for rare drops such as Manuals and Physiques

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Quick hotfix! Some small problems were brought to my attention.


 Natural Health regeneration started was creating problems at startup due to a out of order health calculation.
 If making several breakthroughs without closing the popup there would be an overflow of text. Now it just replace the previous text in minor breakthroughs if the popup window is still visible.
 Some spelling errors and typos were fixed.
